name: WhatsApp Personal
description: WhatsApp Personal is Meta's consumer service for end-to-end encrypted messages, media, voice notes, groups, Status, Channels and voice or video calls using a person's mobile phone number across primary and linked devices. It is distinct from the WhatsApp Business app and WhatsApp Business Platform, whose enterprise APIs are designed for businesses communicating with customers.
agentUseSummary: WhatsApp Personal cannot be connected to Relay agents because Meta publishes no supported OAuth, personal-account API, bot platform or remote MCP service. Phone registration and QR-based linked-device sessions grant broad personal messaging authority rather than bounded scopes, the consumer terms prohibit unauthorized automation and non-personal use, and the WhatsApp Business Platform cannot be repurposed as authority over a consumer account.

blocked.label: Connect or register WhatsApp Personal
blocked.description: Relay cannot register a phone number, receive a verification code, capture a QR code, copy a session or provision itself as a trusted WhatsApp linked device.

blocked.label: Read or export personal data
blocked.description: Messages, media, contacts, groups, Status, Channels, calls, receipts, profiles, device state, backups and encryption material cannot be read, searched, synchronized, exported or disclosed to agents.

blocked.label: Send or manage messages
blocked.description: Agents cannot send, reply, react, edit, delete, forward, schedule, mark read, manage groups, publish Status or Channels, or change account, device and privacy settings.

blocked.label: Make or manage calls
blocked.description: Voice and video calls, group calls, ringing, answering, call links, media, screen sharing and call controls are unavailable.

blocked.label: Automate or bulk message
blocked.description: Auto-messaging, auto-dialing, bulk messaging, automated accounts, scraping, unsolicited communication and non-personal use without authorization are blocked by Relay and WhatsApp's terms.

blocked.label: Use unofficial or private access
blocked.description: WhatsApp Web session tokens, copied cookies, QR interception, browser or UI automation, local databases, device backups, unofficial libraries, modified clients and reverse-engineered APIs are never accepted.

blocked.label: Repurpose WhatsApp Business Platform
blocked.description: Business Platform credentials, business phone numbers and customer-messaging APIs cannot authorize access to a person's consumer WhatsApp account or private conversations.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No WhatsApp Personal action is enabled because Meta provides no supported third-party personal-account automation contract and Relay will not become an automated linked device.

providerSetup.blocker: WhatsApp Personal is a consumer communication service registered to a person's mobile phone number. Its official secondary-device path is an interactive linked-device ceremony, including QR approval, that creates a broadly trusted client rather than a scoped third-party token. Meta publishes no supported OAuth, personal-account, bot or automation API for consumer WhatsApp. The consumer terms prohibit bulk messaging, auto-messaging, auto-dialing, unauthorized non-personal use, automated account creation, unauthorized service access, unauthorized user-data collection and software or APIs that interact with the service without authorization. Meta's documented programmable interface is the separate WhatsApp Business Platform: enterprise-level APIs for businesses engaging customers, not authority to a person's consumer account. Relay therefore has no bounded credential, lawful automation contract or safe personal-data scope to expose.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not ask for a phone number, verification code, two-step verification PIN, QR scan, linked-device session, cookie, backup, encryption key or local WhatsApp data. Do not automate WhatsApp Web or official clients, install unofficial libraries, call reverse-engineered endpoints or substitute WhatsApp Business Platform credentials for personal authority. Keep WhatsApp Personal unavailable unless Meta publishes a supported distributable personal developer API with bounded scopes and terms permitting agent automation, or grants Relay written authorization for an exact reviewed contract. A future user-present click-to-chat or share affordance may open WhatsApp with prefilled content only if the person remains responsible for the final send; it is not a connected provider or agent tool.

evidence.supports: WhatsApp presents the consumer product as private messaging and calling across personal devices, not as a third-party developer platform.
WhatsApp documents device linking as an interactive end-user flow rather than OAuth or delegated application authorization.
WhatsApp describes linked devices as additional clients of the same personal account, with no bounded third-party agent scope.

WhatsApp's consumer terms prohibit bulk messaging, auto-messaging, auto-dialing, unauthorized non-personal use, automated accounts, unauthorized access and collection, and unauthorized software or APIs.
WhatsApp's privacy policy describes consumer account, device, communication and service data handled by the personal service.

Meta describes WhatsApp Business Platform as enterprise-level APIs for businesses engaging customers, establishing that its programmatic authority is a separate business product rather than a personal-account API.
Meta describes the WhatsApp Business app as a separate product built for small business owners communicating with customers.
